objective: Stabilize the versioned JSON contract, CLI errors, exit codes, deterministic output, and Windows/Linux continuous tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Publish machine-verifiable schemas for inspect and compare schemaVersion 1 outputs.
Define and test stable exit codes for success, invocation errors, missing files, invalid JSON, oversize input, and unsupported manifest versions.
JSON stdout contains only JSON; diagnostics use stderr; ordering and fingerprints remain deterministic.
Default output does not expose an absolute local path or unrelated environment data.
CI runs supported Node versions on current Windows and Linux runners without secrets, deployment, publication, or write credentials.
All public-safety and product tests pass.
stopConditions: Compatibility would require silently changing schemaVersion 1 semantics.
A workflow requests a secret or write permission.
Three attempts fail on the same issue.
The exact Ox model is unavailable or rate-limited.
deliverable: Changed public files and compact JSON containing schemas, exit-code table, platform matrix, tests, and residual risks.
